comment: Concatenation order of theme.css. One entry per /* SECTION name */. Add a component file (e.g. components/tabs.css) by inserting one entry. Order is cascade order: moving an entry can change the look; verify with tools/build-compare.mjs and tools/style-diff.mjs.

parts.name: tokens
parts.note: Base variables. Built from foundation/tokens.css after the palette conversion in build-runtime.mjs.

parts.name: native-icons
parts.note: Icon/background data-URI variables generated in build-runtime.mjs from original-assets SVGs.

parts.name: fonts
parts.note: Both OFL notices and all embedded @font-face rules. Default-font application stays in foundation/body-typography.css (body-typography): moving it here would cross foundation/windose-palette.css、regions/app-frame.css、entity-dialog/banner-avatar.css、components/avatar-base.css、foundation/app-utilities.css、regions/sidebar/compact-and-reduced.css and change the cascade.

parts.name: sidebar-nav
parts.note: Owns sidebar navigation items. Follows motion/chrome-decorations.css (rather than sidebar-navigation) to preserve the former later position of the R8 active-item cursor while keeping all nav rules unlayered.

parts.name: popup
parts.note: Owns popup shells, menu states and tooltips after legacy owners; layered defaults yield to unlayered structural exceptions.

parts.name: dialog
parts.note: Owns dialogs, alerts and sheets; follows former owners, with unlayered precedence to retain legacy cascade over app defaults.

parts.name: badge
parts.note: Owns Badge/Kbd defaults, count modifier and pink-surface accents. Placed after legacy owners it replaces; defaults are layered so bell and other unlayered exceptions retain precedence.

parts.name: calendar
parts.note: Owns Calendar paint, immediately before components/object-row.css 至 components/progress-custom.css 的连续片段 to retain its former cascade position; zero-specificity hosts now include dialogs and sheets.

parts.name: misc
parts.note: Owns inline alerts, shared separators, pagination and empty states; alert declarations move only across unrelated badge/data rules, with unchanged specificity.

parts.name: splitter
parts.note: Owns shared draggable handles; follows data-surfaces where generic handle paint lived and retains the former later splitter-r97 cascade position.

parts.name: table
parts.note: Owns rendered table surfaces and row states after the former data-surfaces owner; placed here to preserve cascade position while migrating rules. Ordinary hover deliberately retains #302650.

parts.name: timeline
parts.note: Owns only timeline marker/connector/date paint; follows table for isolated component styling and preserves app-provided size/status classes.

parts.name: card
parts.note: Owns Card defaults and modifiers; immediately after settings-tools-cards, the last legacy card owner. The jirai-card layer intentionally yields to unlayered login/entity exceptions.

parts.name: tabs
parts.note: Owns every Tabs skin rule. Placed right after settings-tools-cards, the last fragment that used to hold Tabs rules, so moved rules only move later. The @layer jirai-tabs block is the only named layer, so its priority is position-independent.

parts.name: toggle-group
parts.note: Owns ToggleGroup default skin; after the prior toolbar rule owners; isolated in jirai-toggle-group layer.

parts.name: button
parts.note: Owns the Button default skin and its three modifier levels. Last named layer before the choice layer.

parts.name: fields
parts.note: Unlayered field-suite owner after components/button.css: field-scoped rules must override the final jirai-button layer without !important.

parts.name: choice
parts.note: Owns checkbox, radio, native range, and Base UI slider appearance; last so component state rules are consolidated after their legacy owners. Switch remains in components/switch.css、foundation/scrollbars.css、components/progress.css.
